title: The support of a constructible sheaf of modules on a qcqs scheme is well defined and constructible
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal G$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let
$$
\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal G)=\{x\in X:\ \mathcal G_{ ar x}
eq0	ext{ for some geometric point } ar x	ext{ of }X	ext{ lying over }x\}
$$
[def-weil-geometric-point], where $\mathcal G_{ ar x}$ is the stalk of the underlying abelian sheaf of $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then: (i) for $x\in X$ and two geometric points $ ar x, ar x'$ of $X$ lying over $x$, $\mathcal G_{ ar x}=0$ if and only if $\mathcal G_{ ar x'}=0$; so $x
otin\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal G)$ as soon as $\mathcal G_{ ar x}=0$ for one geometric point $ ar x$ over $x$ (Stacks' 'for any (some) geometric point', Definition 04FS); (ii) $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal G)$ is a constructible subset of the underlying topological space of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 09YS (lemma-support-constructible, line 11867), part (3), for Lambda finite (hence Noetherian); proof omitted in Stacks ('The proof of (2) and (3) is omitted'; part (1) is proved by a common refinement of stratifications and Lemma lemma-morphism-locally-constant); support as in Definition 04FS (definition-support); clause (i) is the paragraph before Definition 04FS with Remark 04FN (remark-map-stalks, line 3416)
